title: Two Sum Target
statement: Given an integer array `nums` and an integer `target`, return the indices `[i, j]` of the two numbers such that they add up to `target`. Assume exactly one solution exists.
input_format:
First line contains space-separated integers representing the array `nums`.
Second line contains integer `target`.

title: Reverse Words in a String
statement: Given an input string `s`, reverse the order of the words. A word is defined as a sequence of non-space characters. The words in `s` will be separated by at least one space. Return a string of the words in reverse order concatenated by a single space.

starter_code.python:
import sys

def solve():
    s = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    words = s.split()
    print(' '.join(reversed(words)))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    solve()

title: Valid Parentheses Syntax
statement:
Given a string `s` containing just the characters `'('`, `')'`, `'{'`, `'}'`, `'['` and `']'`, determine if the input string is valid.

An input string is valid if:
1. Open brackets must be closed by the same type of brackets.
2. Open brackets must be closed in the correct order.

Print `true` if valid, otherwise `false`.
